data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a gross prior year reserve release of GBP 6.543 million in 2021, representing a 7.28% reduction of opening gross claims outstanding. This release is primarily attributed to favorable claims development. The 2019 year of account closed with a profit despite being impacted by the COVID-19 pandemic and natural catastrophe events such as Hurricanes Sally, Laura, and Zeta. The 2020 year of account was also impacted by the COVID-19 pandemic, the Texas winter freeze in 2021, and natural catastrophe events including Hurricanes Sally, Laura, and Zeta, but is forecast to make a mid-point profit.
raw_causal_phrases: The 2019 YOA has closed with a profit of GBP 0.7m
The YOA has been impacted by losses arising from the COVID-19 pandemic, as well as a series of natural catastrophe events - predominately Hurricanes Sally, Laura and Zeta

The 2020 YOA is forecast at the 24 months to make a mid-point profit of GBP 20.4m. The YOA has also been impacted by losses arising from the COVID-19 pandemic and the Texas winter freeze in 2021, as well as a series of natural catastrophe events in 2020 - the largest being Hurricanes Sally, Laura and Zeta.
data.data_quality_notes: The prior year development figure is taken from the 'Movement arising from prior years' in the financial statements, which is a direct accounting entry. A calculation based on the gross claims development triangle on page 12 yields a different result (+5.208m strengthening vs. -6.543m release), indicating a discrepancy between the accounting movement and the triangle's implied development. The gross premium mix is derived from the Managing Agent's divisional summary as no regulatory segmental analysis note was found.
